slides.title: "Perilously close to all-out war"
slides.body: Crisis Group on Ethiopia and Eritrea, via AFP

slides.title: A militia claims Eritrean losses
slides.body: A Tigray Peace Force spokesperson told AFP Eritrean troops suffered "heavy losses" and are pulling back. AFP could not verify it.

slides.title: Eritrea says the militia is not trustworthy
slides.body: Information Minister Yemane Gebremeskel called rumors of Ethiopian troops crossing into Eritrea "absolutely false."
A foreign security source told AFP 5,000 to 8,000 Eritrean troops were inside Ethiopia. Eritrea denies the accusation. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Two accusations, no confirmation
slides.body: Ethiopia accuses Eritrea of backing the TPLF. Eritrea says Ethiopia may seek a pretext to seize Assab port.

slides.title: Missing from the report
slides.body: The AFP report gave no figures on civilian casualties or displacement.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Allow independent monitoring. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: AFP via Africanews, "Eritrean forces suffer 'heavy losses'..." · Oct 15, 2026

card.title: Claimed Eritrean troops in Ethiopia
card.body: Upper estimate of 5,000-8,000, per a foreign security source to AFP. Eritrea denies it. Unverified.
